newsitem.title: USA: Santa Barbara to acquire Citizens State.
newsitem.headline: Santa Barbara to acquire Citizens State.

text.p: Santa Barbara Bancorp and Citizens State Bank of Santa Paula said on Tuesday that Santa Barbara agreed to acquire Citizens State for $16.17 million.
The agreement provides for Citizens State Bank shareholders to receive $1,925 in cash for each of the 8,400 Citizens' shares outstanding, the companies said in a joint statement.
The transaction, valued at $16.17 million, represents 1.79 times Citizens' estimated book value at March 31, 1997, and 14.3 times 1996 earnings, the companies said.
The merger is anticipated to close at the end of the third quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory approval and the approval of Citizens State Bank shareholders.
